in_hebrew.name: Penelopa
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Weaver of All
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Penelopa הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Penelope was the wife of Odysseus. Her name means 'Weaver of All'. Despite numerous suitors trying to marry her during her husband's long absence, she remained loyal and faithful.

in_greek.name: Πενελόπη
in_greek.long_meaning: Bright, clear, and resplendent chest (or face)

in_latin.name: Penelopa
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Weaver of All
in_latin.long_meaning: Penelopa est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. In Greek mythology, Penelope was the wife of Odysseus. Her name means 'Weaver of All'. Despite numerous suitors trying to marry her during her husband's long absence, she remained loyal and faithful.
